doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Hank Mobley and Wayne Shorter with Blakey
summary: He never saw Hank Mobley live, but saw Wayne Shorter with Miles and with Art Blakey.

bands.name: Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Scorched earth. And one more, what about Hank Mobley?
Never got to see him live.
It’s a shame. You know by the time I saw Miles it was with Wayne. And I saw Wayne with Art Blakey and Freddie Hubbard and Curtis Fuller and Jimmy Merritt. Cedar Walton.
